Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Mikyle Louis and Kraigg Brathwaite to open for West Indies. Sajid Khan to bowl first.  A slip in place.
...SECOND INNINGS...

Mohammad Rizwan was the key wicket for West Indies but he too fell in the phase where a lot was happening. West Indies stuck to the basics and let the ball do the job. On a raging pitch which was offering a lot, West Indies bowled spinners. It was surprising to see Gudakesh Motie not bowl much but Jomel Warrican and Kevin Sinclair did the job today, before the Jayden Seales show which wrapped the top order for not much on the board. This is a decent total on a turning track. Pakistan will come hard against an inexperienced West Indies side. They have to be very careful. Join us back after the Lunch break for the second session.

That's a fine recovery from West Indies and they will be happy with how they have bowled. A quick word from Kraigg Brathwaite to his players are they leave the field. Jomel Warrican and Kevin Sinclair bowled throughout the session. Pakistan were on top before the drinks break, the duo of Shakeel and Mohammad Rizwan added more than 100 and looked in control of their innings but first ball after the first hour saw a lapse in concentration from Shakeel as he edged one to the keeper and that started a downfall.

Commentary.Commentary: All set for action. Time for the national anthems. It will be of the visitors' side followed by Pakistan's. The Windies players are out in the middle. Shan Masood and the debutant, Muhammad Hurraira to open for Pakistan. Gudakesh Motie to bowl first. Let's play...
Kraigg Brathwaite says they want to be brave with the bat and be disciplined with the ball. Shares they are ready for the series. Informs about the team.
